newsitem.title: UK: Iceland slips on press comment, downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Iceland slips on press comment, downgrade.

text.p: Shares in British frozen food chain Iceland Group Plc retreated on Thursday following a negative press comment and talk of broker downgrades, dealers said.
At 1223 GMT, the shares were down 4-1/2p to 95, following Wednesday's 12p-surge sparked by news of a share buyback.
But negative comments in the Financial Times newspaper's Lex Column dampened interest, dealers said.

The newspaper said the speciality food retailer's financial restructuring, "...does not address the fundamental problem, which is that its niche as the high street seller of frozen foods is rapidly evaporating."
NatWest, meanwhile, said it downgraded the stock to "reduce" from "hold."
BZW and SBC Warburg were said to have told their clients to sell Iceland shares, although the brokerages were not immediately available to comment.
